headline: Canada Issues 15-Day Ultimatum to Stelco Over 500 Steel Plant Layoffs
summary: Industry Minister Mélanie Joly gave steelmaker Stelco 15 days to comply with its legally binding employment commitments or face court action following plans to lay off 500 workers.
why: Government enforcement of industrial job pledges impacts foreign takeovers and capital investment agreements in the North American metals sector.

impacts.name: Stelco Holdings Inc
impacts.why: Potential court proceedings and regulatory penalties threaten restructuring and workforce plans.
